title: Won’t last long
text:
Won’t last long. I’ve searched for 2 years for new bar stools and finally bit the bullet and purchased these.
If you’re a heavy person steer away. My husband weighs 300lbs and I’m a portly 240. My husband spends a lot of time sitting at our counter. I’ve had these a month and can already tell his chair seat is leaning to the left as if the bracket under the chair is bent. They do slide very easily and are super easy to put together. They look stunning and are comfortable, however they’re not real easy to get into. The material doesn’t let you “slide” into your comfy place so you have to stand up and try to sit down where you think it’s going to be comfortable. Not a huge deal but a bit of a nuisance.
